archetypes.name: dyn-sweep-state
archetypes.rationale: Sweep state must advance only after validated final report artifacts exist.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the analyze-bugs sweep report integration. Verify artifact identity and stale-tip checks fail closed, pending SHA coverage is retained, and sweep-state.json is written only after report and follow-up artifacts succeed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
